caption: A woman in a beige top at a counter reaches one hand into a green basket of snack packets and rummages through them, then pulls back and turns to reach down toward a dark bag at her side.

labels.action: holds hands together at the counter edge
reaches one hand toward the green basket
rummages among snack packets in the basket while the other hand rests near the basket rim
withdraws hands to the counter edge; unclear whether anything is held
turns and reaches down toward a dark bag at her side, partly out of frame

scene.setting: lobby cafe counter with snack basket and coffee urns
scene.lighting: even indoor overhead light with daylight from windows
scene.viewpoint: high angle from behind-left of the woman

issues: Hands are small and soft, which hand acts cannot be determined, and it is unclear whether a packet is taken before she turns away and her hands go partly out of frame.
